report.explanation: All admitted evidence is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 71ms, gateway/order error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. No observation substantiates any taxonomy cause, and no counter-hypothesis is established. Insufficient evidence to name a bounded root cause; hand off for degraded-signal confirmation and dependency-level telemetry.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or p95 latency) in the alert window; current metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms.
Per-dependency latency/timeout data for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql to test downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion.
Redis timeout/error metrics for inventory->redis to test redis-timeout.
Configuration change records or deployment facts to test bad-configuration.
Longer memory-retention time series per service to test memory-leak.
